@graph.name: Is a WizCommerce alternative the only way to get spoken orders?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You can keep WizCommerce and bring us in for the accounts who prefer talking an order through to writing one. Everything their platform does now carries on. The difference is that some orders arrive already built as lines, so there is less for the assistant and your team to read.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than WizCommerce?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at what they are built for: reading a handwritten sheet, quoting an inquiry, running a store, customer records or payments. We do none of it. Where we are stronger is one step, an order the buyer builds and approves, so your team is not left decoding a message. That is a reason to run us next to their platform rather than instead of it.

They do: voice notes are on their own list of what the assistant reads, alongside scans and handwriting. So a WizCommerce alternative pitched on voice alone would be wrong. The difference is when the order takes shape. A note gets interpreted after the fact, while in our app the speaking builds the lines and the buyer approves them before anything is sent.

@graph.name: Is WizCommerce linked to VoiceOrder Solutions in any way?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. There is nothing between them, and each company supports only its own product. Each sends its orders into your own system separately: theirs through their ERP connections, ours as email, EDI, API or QuickBooks. Neither one routes through the other.

@graph.name: Will storefront buyers need a second way to order?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only if you choose to give them one. Our app is for any kitchen that still phones, emails a scan or sends a spreadsheet. Be clear on one limit: a call or a voicemail to your desk gets no order number from us, no timestamp and nothing moving against stock. Only orders placed in the app do.

@graph.name: How fast could spoken orders be running?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most distributors have the app live in 24 to 48 hours, and most kitchens manage a first order that day. Nothing in WizCommerce has to change, so the platform keeps running while your first few accounts start speaking orders.

@graph.name: How is pricing handled if we keep both?

acceptedAnswer.text: We quote per distributor and publish nothing, and they quote their platform too. The one price list they publish is for their AI photo product, which has its own page and tiers. Keeping WizCommerce means the only new cost is our app, and a quote from us covers that.

@graph.name: Where do the WizCommerce details on this page come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: The WizCommerce facts above were checked at wizcommerce.com, dated 10 October 2026: the product family, the assistant's own list of what it reads, the review step and their industry pages. We do not repeat their performance numbers, which are theirs to stand behind. Anything that has moved since is a mistake at our end.
